description: This file implements the core functions for the Ansc Lpc Connector Object, including creation, initialization, enrollment of internal objects, and cleanup procedures. It defines the functions to create, initialize, and remove the connector object, as well as to set up internal interfaces and timers used for network communication management within the ANSC framework.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscLpccoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs a new Ansc Lpc Connector Object, initializing its member variables and function pointers, and returning a handle to the new object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources associated with the specified connector object, including internal interfaces, timers, and locks.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes internal interfaces such as the IMC and CPC interfaces, the connection timer object, and the connection timer client. Enrolls additional objects needed for connector operation.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Performs member initialization of the connector object, setting default values for its fields and preparing it for operation.
